cases.title: The Disappearing Current Report
cases.target_concept: electric current in a simple series circuit
cases.foil: current is used up by each bulb
cases.disaster: A lab note says less current returns to the battery after the bulb.
key_clues: charge does not disappear in the bulb
cases.safe_zone: Current is the same at every point in a simple series circuit.
cases.filing_note: The bulb transfers energy; it does not consume charge.
cases.student_task: Mark the unsafe claim and replace it with the safe circuit rule.

teacher_only.rationale: Students conflate energy transfer with charge consumption.
teacher_only.answer_key: Current remains equal around the loop.

student_challenges.prompt: A diagram labels smaller current after a bulb. What is unsafe?

teacher_only.rationale: This case separates charge flow from energy transfer.
teacher_only.answer_key: The current label should be equal before and after the bulb.
